title: SESSION318_SEED_CERTIFICATION_INVENTORY — Packs C/D Domain E Unprocessed Seeds
purpose: Comprehensive inventory and readiness assessment of the 38 retained Unprocessed Domain E seed items across Pack C and Pack D, supporting Wave 4+ certification planning under CAQS §1.6.

packs_excluded: Pack A Section E (covered by SESSION804_SEED_SELECTION.json — 5 seeds, 22 clone-group items, 17 archived)
Pack B Section E (75/75 Certified — gold standard benchmark, no seeds needed)
Pack E Section E (75/75 Certified — educationally thin, not suitable as benchmark)
scope.source_of_truth: pack_c_corrected.js and pack_d_corrected.js (dual-block metadata+content architecture, QID prefix P1-EC- and P1-ED-)

inventory_summary.certification_target: 38 seeds certified per CAQS §1.6, plus 43 replacement items for clone-group coverage = 81 total Domain E certifications (current: 30/81 = 37.0%)

item_completeness_assessment.verdict: PARTIALLY_COMPLETE — Items are NOT stubs but have significant EW (ExplanationWrong) gaps preventing certification

stem.quality: Template-generated with company-name rotation pattern. Stems are functional but not CMS exam-level: they are brief (1-2 sentences), use fictional company names (Ashford, Emberton, Ironvale, Bramblewood), and test concept identification rather than application. Substantial rewrite needed for CAQS §1.6 certification.

choices.quality: 4-choice single-select (A/B/C/D). Choice text is template-generated with correct answer rotated across positions. Distractors are recognizable as wrong but lack the nuanced plausibility of CMA-style traps. No exhibits, calculation support, or multi-part scenarios.

correct_choice.quality: Answer key letter correctly assigned. However, CorrectChoice rotates across items within clone groups, making the key predictable across packs (e.g., Pack C seed CC=A, Pack D equivalent seed CC=B for the same concept).

explanation_correct.quality: CRITICALLY_THIN — EC length is 80-120 chars for most seeds (confirmed via inspection of P1-EC-004 EC='Segregation of duties separates authorization, recordkeeping, and reconciliation responsibilities...' ≈ 120 chars). No COSO principle citations. No framework references. No common-exam-trap discussion. These are 1:10 the length of Pack A Section E seeds (avg 923 chars) and 1:4 the length of Pack B Section E benchmark items (400+ chars). EC requires complete rewrite or substantial expansion for CAQS §1.6 compliance.

explanation_wrong.status: PARTIALLY_FILLED — 1 to 3 slots empty per item
explanation_wrong.pattern: Template-fill: the ExplanationWrong slot corresponding to the CorrectChoice is always empty (DL-008 compliant), but 1-2 additional non-CC EW slots are also empty strings. Only 1-2 EW slots per item contain substantive text, and even filled slots use generic boilerplate ('Option X represents a plausible misconception...').

example_p1_ec_004.EW_B: Cost-benefit analysis may influence control design, but it is not the control concept shown by separating authorization, recording, and reconciliation.
example_p1_ec_004.EW_C: Management override is a bypass of controls by someone with authority; here, duties are separated rather than bypassed.

example_p1_ed_001.EW_C: The balanced scorecard is a performance measurement tool, not a governance model for control responsibilities.
example_p1_ed_001.EW_D: COSO ERM is broader risk-management guidance; the distinct operational, oversight, and internal-audit layers describe the three lines model.

explanation_wrong.ew_gap_count_estimate: ~76 empty EW slots across 38 items (average ~2 empties per item). All slots need choice-specific explanations meeting the ≥100 char threshold per S311 Authoring Quality Gate.

los_tag.quality: UNIFORMLY_COARSE — every single item uses LOSTag='E Internal controls' with no finer-grained sub-tag (e.g., E.1.a, E.1.e, E.1.g). This makes it impossible to verify blueprint coverage distribution without manual topic-to-LOS mapping. Pack B Section E serves as the distribution target.

metadata_fields.difficulty: Uniformly 'Moderate' across all 38 items — no calibration. DL-031 recalibration required.
metadata_fields.difficulty_score: Values of 1, 2, or 3 with no apparent calibration standard.
metadata_fields.cognitive_level: Mixture of 'Understand' and 'Apply' — needs audit against actual cognitive demand.
metadata_fields.production_status: All 38 items lack ProductionStatus field entirely — must be set to 'Draft' before certification pipeline.

seed_inventory_for_packs_c_d.status: MISSING — This report (SESSION318_SEED_INVENTORY.json) is the FIRST comprehensive seed inventory for Packs C/D Domain E.
prior_artifacts: SESSION804_SEED_SELECTION.json — covers ONLY Pack A Section E (5 seed groups, 22 clone items, 17 archived). Does not address Packs C/D.
SESSION311_DOMAIN_E_INVENTORY.json — high-level pack-level counts (19 Unprocessed per pack) but no item-level QID lists, no EW gap analysis, no completeness assessment.
SESSION307_DOMAIN_E_REMEDIATION_PLAN.json — phase-level plan for 178 Domain E items but predates the 800-series certification methodology and does not enumerate Pack C/D seed QIDs.
SESSION318_PRODUCTION_INSERTION_PACKAGE.json — notes 'seed_certifications: 38' and 'seed_sources: Packs C/D Unprocessed Domain E items' but provides no QID-level detail.

clone_group_symmetry_documentation.status: MISSING — No artifact documents the symmetry between Pack C and Pack D clone groups. The 56-archived + 19-retained pattern appears to be identical in structure (same rotation template, same topics, different company names and CC letters), but this has never been formally cross-referenced.
clone_group_symmetry_documentation.implication: Without cross-pack symmetry documentation, there is risk that certified Pack C seeds and certified Pack D seeds may be clones of each other (same concept, different company name), defeating the purpose of seed retention.

qid_to_topic_mapping.status: MISSING — No artifact maps each P1-EC-XXX and P1-ED-XXX QID to its Topic/MicroTopic/UniqueConceptKey. The Topic fields exist in the source files but have not been extracted into a seed inventory. This blocks prioritization by blueprint LOS coverage.

ew_gap_ledger.status: MISSING — No per-item ledger of which EW slots are empty and which are filled. SESSION307_EW_DEBT_REGISTRY.json covers Domain E at aggregate level (141 items) but does not enumerate Pack C/D seed QIDs.

certification_readiness_assessment.overall_verdict: NOT_READY — All 38 seeds require significant remediation before they can enter the CAQS §1.6 certification pipeline.

ec_adequacy.detail: EC across all 38 seeds is 80-120 chars of generic definition-level text. No COSO citations, no business interpretation, no exam-trap discussion. Must be expanded to 400+ chars per S311 Authoring Quality Gate and ideally 800+ chars to match Pack A seed quality (avg 923 chars).

ew_completeness.detail: ~76 empty EW slots across 38 items. Filled slots use template boilerplate ('Option X represents a plausible misconception...'). All EW must be rewritten as choice-specific explanations ≥100 chars addressing why the specific distractor is wrong and what misconception it targets.

stem_quality.detail: Stems are 1-2 sentences testing concept identification ('What framework is this?'). CMA exam stems test application through scenarios. Most stems need rewrite to add business context, decision points, and scenario complexity.

distractor_quality.detail: Distractors are template-generated and recognizable by CMA candidates as too-obviously-wrong. Need rewrite for plausibility (S302 DQS dimension). The same distractors appear across Pack C/D seeds for equivalent topics, creating cross-pack answer predictability.

los_tag_precision.detail: All 38 items tagged 'E Internal controls' with no sub-tag. Per S311 Authoring Quality Gate, LOSTags must use fine-grained format (e.g., 'E.1.e Control Activities', 'E.1.g Monitoring Activities'). Every item needs LOSTag recalibration using Pack B Section E distribution as target.

metadata_calibration.detail: Difficulty uniformly 'Moderate', DifficultyScore 1-3, CognitiveLevel mixed Understand/Apply. Per DL-031 findings, many of these items have lower actual cognitive demand than their metadata suggests. Recalibration needed.

dl_defect_status.dl_008: PASS — CC-slot EW is empty in all inspected items (correct). No DL-008 violations detected.
dl_defect_status.dl_013: FAIL — EC text is boilerplate-short (80-120 chars). This is a structural DL-013 concern because the EC does not provide sufficient instructional value to justify item retention as a 'seed.'
dl_defect_status.dl_026: PARTIAL — Non-CC EW slots are sometimes empty (1-2 empties per item). DL-026 requires all non-CC EW slots to be non-empty.
dl_defect_status.dl_031: FAIL — Difficulty/CognitiveLevel calibration is unverified for all 38 items.
dl_defect_status.dl_016: POSSIBLE — Dual-block architecture (metadata + content blocks) may cause metadata-content offset per the Pack A finding. Needs verification on Pack C/D.

estimated_remediation_effort.per_item_hours: 1.5-2.5 hours per seed (EC expansion + 3 EW authoring + stem/distractor rewrite + LOSTag + metadata)
estimated_remediation_effort.comparison_note: This is comparable to the replacement-item authoring effort (43 items at similar per-item cost). The total Domain E certification workload of 81 items (38 seeds + 43 replacements) represents the largest remaining certification block in the Part 1 portfolio.

phase_1_immediate.label: Complete Wave 2b Insertion (10 items)
phase_1_immediate.rationale: These 10 items are already authored (SESSION808_AUTHORING_BATCH_WAVE2B.json), quality-gated, and in Draft/Unprocessed state. They need insertion into pack_e_corrected.js and registry updates before seed certification begins. Delaying insertion creates a backlog bottleneck — these are the last Wave 2b items and unblock the remaining replacement groups.
phase_1_immediate.effort: LOW — insertion + registry update only (1 session)

phase_2.label: Author Remaining Wave 4 Replacement Items (13 items)
phase_2.rationale: 3 remaining replacement groups need items to close clone-group coverage gaps. These 10 QIDs plus any additional groups identified during seed topic audit.

phase_3.label: Pack C/D Seed Cross-Reference Audit
phase_3.rationale: Before certifying Pack C and Pack D seeds independently, verify that seeds retained in each pack do not duplicate each other (same concept, different company name). The clone-group rotation pattern is symmetric across packs — Pack C seed for topic X may be conceptually identical to Pack D seed for topic X. If confirmed, consolidate to one seed per topic across both packs.
phase_3.dependency: May reduce Phase 4 workload from 38 to ~19 seeds

phase_4.label: Seed Certification Pipeline (38 or fewer seeds)

sub_phases.label: EW Gap Fill
sub_phases.description: Author choice-specific ExplanationWrong for all empty slots (~76 slots). Minimum 100 chars per slot per S311 Quality Gate. Target 200+ chars for instructional value.

sub_phases.label: EC Expansion
sub_phases.description: Expand ExplanationCorrect from 80-120 chars to 400+ chars. Add COSO principle citations, business interpretation, common exam traps, and framework references.

sub_phases.label: Stem/Distractor Rewrite
sub_phases.description: Rewrite stems for application-level scenarios. Rewrite distractors for CMA-style plausibility. Add exhibits where appropriate.

sub_phases.label: LOSTag + Metadata Calibration
sub_phases.description: Replace 'E Internal controls' with fine-grained LOSTags (E.1.a through E.1.i). Apply DL-031 difficulty recalibration.

sub_phases.label: CAQS §1.6 Certification
sub_phases.description: Full six-dimension verification, quality gate review, duplicate prevention check, production insertion.

blocker_note.severity: HIGH — BLOCKS seed certification pipeline start
blocker_note.issue: Ten (10) Wave 2b Domain E replacement items (R12, R13, R18, R21, R22, R23, R24, R25, R28, R33) are fully authored per SESSION808_AUTHORING_BATCH_WAVE2B.json with complete EC (400-500+ chars) and choice-specific EW (100+ chars per slot), but they are NOT yet inserted into pack_e_corrected.js. They remain in Draft/Unprocessed state in the S808 authoring batch only.
why_this_matters: These 10 items close coverage gaps for E.1.e Control Activities (3), E.1.g Monitoring (2), E.1.i External Auditing (2), E.1.a Governance (1), E.1.c Control Environment (1), E.1.f Information & Communication (1).
Without insertion, the Domain E replacement tracker still shows 3 replacement groups as incomplete, which distorts the certification numerator.
Registry updates (Master Question Registry, Question Similarity Ledger, Duplicate Prevention Report) are deferred per S318 and must complete before seed certification begins.
Insertion is the lowest-effort, highest-impact action available — 1 session vs. 9-12 sessions for seeds.
blocker_note.recommended_action: EXECUTE Wave 2b insertion BEFORE any seed certification work begins. Target: S319 or earliest available session. Insert into pack_e_corrected.js using the full item JSON from SESSION808_AUTHORING_BATCH_WAVE2B.json. Update registry. Then begin Phase 3 (Cross-Reference Audit).

current_state.breakdown: 30 Wave 1-3 replacement items certified and inserted. 10 Wave 2b items authored but not inserted. 38 seeds inventoried but not certified. 3 replacement groups still need items authored.

assumptions_and_caveats: QID numbering confirmed via grep of pack_c_corrected.js and pack_d_corrected.js source files; all 38 QIDs exist and carry question_state='Unprocessed'.

The symmetry between Pack C and Pack D clone groups (same rotation template) is inferred from SESSION311 clone-group analysis and preliminary inspection of P1-EC-004 vs P1-ED-001 (different company names, different CC letters, same underlying concept pattern). Formal cross-reference audit is still needed (Phase 3).
EW gap count of ~76 is estimated from the 2-empty-slots-per-item pattern observed in inspected samples (P1-EC-004: 2 empties; P1-ED-001: 2 empties). Actual count may vary ±19.
EC length estimates (80-120 chars) are based on sample inspection. Per-item EC audit is needed for exact measurements.
This report treats the 38 seeds as one pool for certification planning. Phase 3 may reduce this to ~19 if cross-pack duplication is confirmed.
Pack B Section E (75/75 Certified) is the quality benchmark per S311. Pack A Section E seeds (923 avg EC) are the minimum quality bar per S804.
This is the FIRST comprehensive seed-level inventory for Packs C/D. Prior artifacts covered only aggregate counts or Pack A only.
